extracted.intended_audience: researchers and clinicians studying craniofacial anatomy, cleft lip/palate, and medical imaging (scoping-review authors and readers)
extracted.subtask_description: A registered scoping review (PRISMA-ScR) to map and synthesize imaging-based evidence about the zygomaticomaxillary suture (ZMS) in individuals with cleft lip and/or palate (CLP), describing study characteristics, methodological variation, reliability data, and gaps. The page is an OSF preregistration/metadata entry for that review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adherence to PRISMA-ScR guidelines
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use PRISMA-ScR reporting standards for scoping reviews (protocol/registration, eligibility criteria, information sources, selection, data charting, synthesis). The page explicitly states the review will follow these guidelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Map the evidence on ZMS in CLP
rubrics_metrics.description: This scoping review will map the evidence on the zygomaticomaxillary suture (ZMS) in individuals with cleft lip and/or palate (CLP).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Produce an evidence map covering the range of studies, topics, and findings related to ZMS in CLP rather than a narrow meta-analytic estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Focus on ZMS maturation, morphology, and imaging assessment
rubrics_metrics.description: Although circummaxillary sutures are crucial in facial growth and orthopedic treatment planning, no synthesis has focused specifically on ZMS maturation, morphology, and imaging assessment in CLP.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Extract and synthesize study data that address ZMS maturation (developmental stage), morphological features, and how imaging was used to assess these aspects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identify, describe, and categorize imaging-based studies
rubrics_metrics.description: Aims to identify, describe, and categorize all imaging-based studies evaluating ZMS in CLP.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Systematically locate imaging-based research (modalities, populations, study designs), describe their characteristics, and classify them into meaningful categories (e.g., modality type, age group, study aim).

rubrics_metrics.name: Highlight methodological variations
rubrics_metrics.description: Highlighting methodological variations among the included studies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document differences in study design, sampling, imaging protocols, measurement approaches, and analytic methods that could affect findings and comparability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Report reliability data
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Extract and report reliability metrics (e.g., inter- and intra-rater reliability, measurement error) as presented in primary studies, and note where reliability is absent or insufficiently reported.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identify knowledge gaps
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarize areas lacking evidence or consistency (e.g., understudied populations, absent longitudinal data, inconsistent imaging standards) and recommend topics for future research.
